text.description_html:
Laurey 24106, 1-1/8 Inch Antique Pewter Windsor Button Knob

A simple classic, the 1-1/8 Inch Windsor Button Kitchen Cabinet Knob is easy to install. Its traditional design makes it ideal for most homes. The 1-1/8 Inch Windsor Button Knob comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Windsor Knob:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Antique Pewter
  • Diameter: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Sold Individually
